messages.subject: fixed most of the warnings
parts:
I fixed most of the warnings. Almost all of them were
false positives, at least in terms of things we care about,
but I fixed many that I could anyway.

I've grouped the ones that are left (see below). There
are cases I think the code's OK as is, the long long case
we need to fix with some ifdefs or explicitly sized int defs,
and some issues in the test framework I'm going to leave to
Daniel. I think we can fix the unused vars in generated
code, too.

Some ones I couldn't fix involve false positive reports on
unused variables -- you need them there because they supply
default values.

The library code in Boost and Eigen spews an enormous number
of warnings now that we have the warning level turned up.
Most for the same silly reasons as our code had so many warnings.

Most of the warning were from unused variables in parameters
lists (I just wrapped in /* */). Also a bunch of files
without terminating newlines.

The only things that even looked like they could be issues
actually wouldn't be given the way the test code would've
executed (I fixed anyway by initialization variables).

- Bob
